newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish tourist outlet village planned for Goffs.
newsitem.headline: Irish tourist outlet village planned for Goffs.

text.p: Irish International Tourist Outlets Limited said on Tuesday that it planned to develop Ireland's first ever tourist outlet village besides Goff's bloodstock complex in Kildare.

An outlet village consists of a number of retail units located in one centre, allowing prominent fashion houses and major international brands to sell surplus end-of-range and out-of-season items at a discount.

The total cost of the development, which will create 400 jobs, will be in excess of 20 million Irish pounds and it will be known as the Kildare Tourist Outlet Village, the company said in a statement.
Irish International Tourist Outlets Ltd is an affiliate of Value Retail Plc, a UK-based international property developer specialising in outlet villages of this kind.
